title: Project Eagle First Fire Up! (5,000 Horsepower Proline Hemi)

event_next.name: World Cup (Maryland, radial/drag event)
event_next.notes: Eagle to be tested the day before leaving for World Cup

cars.owner_driver: Cleetus McFarland (driver); pedals adjustable so Jackstand could also drive

base_vehicle.materials: lots of carbon and titanium; titanium adjustable steering column; poured seat

lubrication.notes: primed with a drill; oil pump line temporarily swapped (was backwards)

timing_check.notes: timing light check read on zero (TDC reference); '25' said - likely degrees, low confidence

turbo_size_mm.notes: '98s on this thing' - two 98 mm turbos; one each side mounted at firewall area per caption

turbo_speed_monitored.notes: turbo shaft speed sensor added; engine can now overspeed the 98s past efficiency

fuel.notes: large-diameter fuel lines/feed off tank; big injectors; electric primer pump for priming fuel system

ecu.notes: First FuelTech for the channel (normally Holley); chosen because Proline pairs with FuelTech; base tune supplied by Proline; small FuelTech screens in engine bay; FuelTech EGT monitoring

transmission.notes: transmission present; converter bolts being installed

driveshaft.status: missing at fire-up; expected in 1-2 days

electrical.front_end_contact_connectors: body/headlights connect via contact plates - nothing to unplug when removing front end

dyno.kind: claimed - Proline dyno (across the street from FuelTech) made ~5,400 hp with the same engine combo and same turbos (not this specific engine)

power_claims.context: rods every 30 runs at that power regardless of builder

failures.cause: scratch on car touched up overnight by painter Ryan (cosmetic)
taped temporarily; risk of high idle at first start
transmission plug backing out, almost made a mess

maintenance.spares: spare piston and rods; no spare engine

cars.confidence: high for FuelTech/methanol/98 mm twins/dry sump; claimed only for power figures

changes.fact: Doors repaired; window lips stiffened/thickened with more glass (fiberglass) laid in
Both weight bars can be removed
Suspension data showed rear ~1.5 in lower downtrack (car being pushed down)
Body gets front-end contact connectors for headlights like Eagle

passes.notes: caption '692' as fastest ever - ambiguous (could be ET); 'if we can go 205' implies mph goal; low confidence

notes.fact: Previous: added more power; turbo recovered about a tenth quicker on the shift in high gear
World Cup strategy: whether to run with body on or off kept secret

event_refs.fact: 2.4 Hours of LeMullets at Freedom Factory, November 15-16
Mullet to be tested that night back in Bradenton
